workload_lunch_minutes_007.answer: Secondary/Career Centers: 45-60 minutes; Elementary/Special Ed: Minimum 45 minutes daily (or 30 minutes daily if utilizing a 225-min/week schedule)
workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: in no case shall a Teacher’s lunch period be less than 45 minutes or exceed 60 minutes.

workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: The Supervisor shall have the right to call one (1) required general faculty meeting per month.

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: Educational aides and school assistants, who are assigned to the school, shall be scheduled to assist teachers with cafeteria and playground duty.
